text: I can convert an availability target into downtime per year and per month, and show why MTTR is often the cheapest lever.
I can size spare capacity so a service survives losing one zone, for 2, 3 or 4 zones.
I can choose active-active or active-passive for a given tier and walk through an AZ failure timeline second by second.
I can explain what multi-AZ and multi-region each protect against, and what multi-region forces on replication and writes.
I can compute series and parallel availability for a request path, find the weakest link and name the correlated failures the formulas ignore.
